career_path_block.路径: Automated drilling and riveting equipment operation

career_path_block.说明: Experience in exception handling and setup
Understands processes and improves production lines
Carries both management and quality responsibility

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for aircraft assemblers is remaining at purely manual stations, not AI. Automation absorbs repetitive work, while process setup, exception handling, and signed quality control become more valuable as automation spreads.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are quality accountability and station intensity, not AI. Aviation assembly uses signed responsibility, so one incorrectly installed component or missing rivet can have serious consequences. Final assembly lines also have tight cycles, and prolonged standing and precision work create physical strain.
risks: Quality responsibility: heavy pressure from signed accountability
Production pace: demanding final assembly line rhythm
Physical strain: prolonged standing and precision vision
Program dependence: aircraft cycles affect staffing

page.contract_project_risk_block: Automated drilling and riveting machines can install every rivet quickly and accurately, but assemblers must judge whether loads are correct and whether a gap can be accepted. Only their signed judgment can carry responsibility for the entire aircraft.

responsibilities: Adjust control systems and cable tension
Install onboard system lines and components
Measure tolerances and sign assembly records

career_path_block.说明: 重复工位受自动化影响
自动化普及后的核心工位
管理责任与质量一肩挑

career_risk_cards.callout: 飞机装配工最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在纯手工工位」——自动化吃的是重复劳动，而工艺调试、异常处理和签字把关，恰恰是自动化越普及越值钱的能力。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「质量责任与工位强度」：航空装配是签字责任制，装错一个部件、漏打一颗铆钉都可能酿成严重后果，心理压力大；同时总装线节拍紧张，长时间站立和精细操作对身体是持续消耗。
risks: 自动化渗透：纯手工工位减少
质量责任：签字追责压力大
节拍强度：总装线节奏紧张
身体消耗：长期站立与精细用眼
岗位依赖机型：项目周期影响用工

page.contract_project_risk_block: 自动钻铆机能又快又准地打出每一颗铆钉，但「这个部位受力对不对、间隙要不要放行」——这些写进签字记录里的判断，只有装配工能替整架飞机负责。

responsibilities: 按图纸完成飞机结构件装配
调整操纵系统与钢索张力
安装机载系统管路与部件
测量公差并签署装配记录

career_path_block.说明: Many cases and relatively low income
Builds procedural expertise before moving toward arbitrator roles
High premium in construction, finance, and intellectual property

career_risk_cards.callout: The largest risk in arbitration and mediation is difficult entry and slow reputation building, not AI. AI can draft documents but cannot replace judgment that parties accept, and that judgment develops through case experience.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but dependence on public trust and case referrals. Decisions and settlements rely on professional reputation, and a single biased action can destroy credibility. Entry-level mediation has many cases but low pay, while high-end commercial arbitration pays well but has formidable entry barriers.
risks: High barriers: legal qualification exam + practical experience
Referral dependence: reputation determines cases and income
Emotional strain: sustained exposure to conflict and confrontation
Low entry-level pay: many mediation cases but modest compensation
Substantial responsibility: disputed decisions can bring accountability

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can memorize every statute and precedent, but it cannot persuade angry parties to agree. Balancing human interests with legal principles is the most valuable skill in arbitration and mediation.

responsibilities: Preside over hearings and mediation procedures
Review evidence and identify the core disputed issues
Propose settlement options or issue decisions
Write legal documents and manage case progress

career_path_block.说明: 程序熟手，向仲裁员过渡

career_risk_cards.callout: 仲裁调解最大的风险不是 AI，而是「入门难、成名慢」——AI 能替你写文书，替不了你让人服气的判断力，而这份判断力要靠案件喂出来。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「公信力与案源依赖」：裁判和调解靠的是专业口碑，一次偏袒就砸招牌；同时基层调解案源多但收入低，高端商业仲裁收入高但门槛极高。
risks: 门槛高：法考 + 实务双门槛
案源依赖：声誉决定案源与收入
情绪消耗：长期面对冲突与对抗
基层收入低：调解案源多但报酬薄
责任重大：裁决争议大易被追责

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能背下所有法条和判例，但「让两个拍桌子的人同时点头」——这份拿捏人心与法理的分寸，是仲裁调解人最值钱的本事。

responsibilities: 审查证据并把握争议焦点
提出调解方案或作出裁决
撰写文书并管理案件进度

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Computer Network Architects lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk comes from high-risk exposure and unclear accountability, not AI. People remain responsible for Computer Network Architects judgments and final review; AI handles only structured tasks.
risks: Accountability and compliance-boundary pressure in network architecture.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split high risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute network architecture plans.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of network architecture deliverables.
Coordinate resources and drive network projects to completion.
Review and improve network architecture processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——计算机网络架构师的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「高风险敞口 + 责任边界」——计算机网络架构师的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Computer Network Architects领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把高风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Computer Network Architects相关的工作方案。
对Computer Network Architects产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Computer Network Architects项目交付。
复盘优化Computer Network Architects流程与方法。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is market and model risk, not AI alone. A model that works today can fail overnight.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are market cycles and model risk, not AI alone. Firms reduce headcount during weak markets, a failed model can cause major losses, and competition is intense.
risks: Market cycles affect headcount and bonuses
Model failure can cause major losses
Intense competition and high entry requirements

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how fast systems search, people still have to explain why a signal earns returns and what to do in extreme markets. Human judgment and accountability remain central because machines cannot own market uncertainty.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「市场 + 模型风险」——你写的模型，可能一夜之间不灵。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「市场周期 + 模型风险」——行情差时编制收缩，模型一旦失效可能巨亏，竞争极度内卷。
risks: 市场周期影响编制与分红
初级数据岗被 AI 压缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管搜索多快，信号为什么赚钱、极端行情怎么办，最后还得人想明白、人签字——市场的模糊，机器不敢担。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is layout plus cutting software. Systems absorb standard positioning, while workers who coordinate and learn the trade become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is positioning and cutting software. Systems accelerate layout and cutting, but field coordination and physical work still require people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable software becomes, helpers still think through how to hand over and steady components and coordinate on site, then provide the hands and movement. People remain integral to pipeline work.

responsibilities: Maintain safety and learn the trade
skills: Handing over materials and steadying components

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「放线 + 下料软件」——标准位被系统吃，会配合会学艺的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「定位与下料软件」——放线与切割被系统提速，但现场配合与体力仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管软件多聪明，怎么递、怎么扶、现场怎么配，最后还是帮工的脑去想、手去接、脚去跑——管道这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not wholesale replacement by AI, but tools absorbing routine modeling. People with systems capabilities and on-site experience remain more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not wholesale replacement by AI, but CAD automation and generative design absorbing routine modeling. Standardized components are becoming platform-based, and low-end design is outsourced. Complex systems still require people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, engineers still decide which constraints to preserve, how to balance service life against cost, and how to modify designs on site. People continue to think, test, and sign off on equipment.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 整体取代，而是工具把常规建模吃掉，有系统力和现场经验的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是被 AI 整体取代，而是 CAD 自动化与生成式设计吃掉常规建模；标准化部件被平台化，低端设计外包。复杂系统仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪类约束值得保、怎么权衡寿命与成本、现场怎么改，最后还是工程师的脑去想、手去验、字去签——设备这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but CNC machining and 3D printing. Standard prototypes are being absorbed, while people with strong tactile judgment are more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is CNC machining combined with 3D printing. Equipment accelerates standard prototypes, and composite materials replace some wooden models. Complex tactile models, fitting, and customer prototype reviews still require people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart the equipment becomes, model makers still have to carve with their hands, inspect with their eyes, and adjust with their judgment to refine complex curves, match tactile prototypes, and respond to customer revisions. People cannot be fully removed from prototyping.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「数控 + 3D 打印」——标准样被吃，有手感力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「数控化 + 3D 打印」——标准样件被设备加速，且复合材质替代部分木样；同时复杂手感样、修配与客户对样仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管设备多聪明，复杂弧度怎么修、手感样怎么对、客户怎么改，最后还是模型工的手去削、眼去看、脑去调——打样这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automation. Systems absorb route finding and dispatching, while people who dock well and handle incidents become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but automation. Navigation and dispatch systems accelerate some operating tasks, but docking, weather judgment, and emergencies still require people. Water safety and responsibility also create substantial pressure.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent navigation becomes, operators still take the helm and use their judgment to keep boats steady, dock safely, and handle emergencies. People cannot be removed entirely from work on the water.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化」——找路与调度被系统吃，会靠泊、能处置的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不在 AI，而在「自动化」——导航与调度把一部分驾驶提速，但靠泊、天气判断与突发仍要人；同时水上安全与责任压力大。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管导航多聪明，船怎么开稳、怎么靠泊、突发怎么处，最后还是操作员去握舵、去说、去判——水面这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but interlocking + automation. Purely manual roles decline, while people with equipment knowledge who handle emergencies become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but centralized dispatch + automated equipment. Computer interlocking and automated switching reduce staffing, while field emergency response and inspection still require people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, these workers still must decide how to handle field emergencies, listen for unusual equipment sounds, and provide the final safety safeguard, using their hands to throw switches, eyes to watch, and voices to call commands. People cannot be fully removed from train safety.

responsibilities: Operate switches and signals according to procedures

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「联锁 + 自动化」——纯手动岗在减，有设备知识会应急的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「调度集中化 + 自动化设备」——计算机联锁与自动调车减少人手，但现场应急和巡检仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，现场突发怎么断、设备异响怎么听、安全怎么兜底，最后还是这拨人的手去扳、眼去看、嘴去喊——行车安全这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Recreation Workers lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this role is not AI but medium-risk exposure combined with scope of responsibility. Judgment and final review for Recreation Workers still rest with people; AI only handles structurable tasks.
risks: Pressure from responsibility and compliance boundaries in recreation work.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute recreation program plans.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of recreation outcomes.
Coordinate resources and drive delivery of recreation programs.
Review and optimize recreation processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——休闲活动从业人员的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——休闲活动从业人员的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Recreation Workers领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Recreation Workers相关的工作方案。
对Recreation Workers产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Recreation Workers项目交付。
复盘优化Recreation Workers流程与方法。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automated sorting lines. Machines absorb standard sorting, while workers with equipment and hazardous-waste handling skills become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is automated sorting lines. Optical systems absorb standard sorting, while hazardous and mixed materials still need people. Physical and safety pressure also remains substantial.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent a line becomes, workers still use their eyes, hands, and strength to judge hazardous waste, protect equipment, and handle incidents. People cannot be fully removed from recycling.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动分拣线」——标准分拣被机器吃，有设备和危废处置力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化分拣线」——光学分选吃掉标准分拣，但危废与杂料仍要人；且体力与安全压力不小。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管线多聪明，危废怎么判、设备怎么护、现场突发怎么处，最后还是工人的眼去看、手去分、身去扛——循环这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but automated sewing + relocation. Standard sewing is absorbed, while people with tactile fine-finishing skills become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is automated sewing + production relocation. Equipment absorbs standard sewing, while people remain essential for high-end and custom work.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, sewers still decide which stitches must be even, how to control the feel, and whether a garment has defects. Their hands sew, eyes inspect, and minds judge.

responsibilities: Repair defects and submit for inspection

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化车缝 + 转移」——标准车缝被吃，有手感能精修的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化车缝 + 转移」——标准车缝被设备吃，但高档与定制仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪道线迹该匀、手感怎么控、件有没有疵，最后还是缝纫工的手去缝、眼去看、脑去判——缝制这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not wholesale replacement by AI, but pressure on routine operations from autonomous networks and automation. People with strong planning and cutover skills are more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not wholesale replacement by AI, but the loss of routine operations work to network management automation and autonomous networks, combined with rapid shifts between technology generations. Planning and fault-isolation skills are becoming even scarcer.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent the tools become, specialists still decide which links need more capacity, how to execute incident-free cutovers, and how to calculate capacity. Their judgment, signatures, and accountability remain indispensable in communications.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 整体取代，而是「自智网络 + 自动化」压低常规运维——有规划与割接力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI 整体取代，而是「网管自动化 + 自智网络」吃掉常规运维；同时技术代际切换快。规划与故障定位能力反而更稀缺。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪条链路该扩容、怎么割接零事故、容量怎么算，最后还是专家的脑去想、手去签、肩膀去扛——通信这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: High entry barriers and high income
career_path_block.路径: Large-tree pruning / work near energized lines

career_path_block.说明: Leads crews and manages service areas

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for tree trimmers is not AI but falls and electrocution. With strong safety practices and proper credentials, this is a stable and scarce trade.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main occupational risks are falls and electrocution. Climbing and lift-bucket work carry serious fall hazards, and work near power lines is especially dangerous. Outdoor work is also heavily affected by weather, but demand for grounds maintenance remains stable and certified skilled workers are consistently scarce.
risks: Falls from height: risks during lift-bucket and climbing work
Weather: wind and rain can stop work and cause income fluctuations
Occupational injuries: chainsaw hazards and strain from heavy physical work
Seasonality: pruning volume declines in winter

page.contract_project_risk_block: Drones can find dead branches, but they cannot judge whether a tree will remain stable after a cut. Only the arborist in the tree can make that decision.

responsibilities: Maintain safe clearance from utility lines
skills: Operation of chainsaws and other tools

career_risk_cards.callout: 树木修剪工最大的风险不是 AI，而是「高空和触电」——把安全和持证做好，这行是稳定又稀缺的手艺。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要是「高空与触电」：爬树、车斗作业摔伤风险高，电线附近作业更是高危；同时户外作业受天气影响大，但绿化养护需求稳定，持证熟练工始终稀缺。
risks: 高空坠落：车斗与爬树作业风险
触电风险：线路附近作业
天气影响：风雨天停工收入波动
职业伤：电锯与重体力劳损
季节性：冬季修剪量减少

page.contract_project_risk_block: 无人机找得出枯枝，找不出「这一锯下去树稳不稳」的分寸——高空里的判断，只有树上的师傅说了算。
